wave_008_009_refinements: Chapter 90 is now treated as a possible conceptual ancestor of later Potato Field P / UPT language, not as evidence that the 2025 UPT Lagrangian already existed in 2024.
Quantum Tuber has been isolated as a recovery target: search drafts for any symbol, spin, charge, mass, potential or explicit field equation.
Book entanglement language is now constrained by Bell/CHSH and no-signaling distinctions; universal-root symbolism is not a Bell experiment.
Chapter 91's dark matter/dark energy complementarity is preserved historically but scientifically split into separately typed sectors.
Baseline Friedmann, continuity, Poisson and linear-growth equations are supplied in the detailed recovery as external comparators rather than retroactively attributed to the book.
Human Map equations are now separately audited for dimensional consistency and operational measurement.
important_book_quotes_paraphrased: The Potatoverse can be thought of as a cosmic potato field where beings/worlds are ripples in the Potato Archetype.
Everything-is-potato is explicitly compared to the unified-field idea that forces and particles are expressions of one underlying field.
Chapter 82 explicitly frames hidden dimensions and string/M-theory as routes toward force unification.
Chapter 90 says its purpose is to unify quantum mysteries with Potatoverse metaphors and connect particles, forces and universal unity.
Chapter 91 describes dark matter and dark energy as complementary aspects of one cosmic soil/growth framework.
boundaries: Book statements about entanglement should not be interpreted as universal instantaneous causal influence between all objects.
The book's support percentages and some neuroscience/field values are not reliable scientific consensus metrics and require source-by-source auditing.
Dark matter/dark energy soil language is metaphorical and does not constitute a physical solution to either problem.
Unified-field language is historically important to Tim's project even where it is not yet predictive physics.
The Higgs field does not account for all ordinary mass in the simplistic sense; QCD dynamics dominate much of hadronic mass.
A shared metaphorical substrate is not by itself a physical unification mechanism.
